'''Feldwes''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Feldwes system/Legends|Feldwes system]]. It was situated in the [[Back Reach]] area of the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] within the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Trans-Hydian]] portion of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] known as the [[Ardan Cross]] connected it to the [[Arda system/Legends|Arda]] and [[Pygorix system/Legends|Pygorix systems]].<ref name="TEA" />

Feldwes was a [[Factory world/Legends|factory world]] that served as an industrial powerhouse of the Back Reach, with members of the [[B'trillan]], [[Human/Legends|Human]], and [[T'sarki]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from across the region wishing to procure permits for working there. After the [[Mining/Legends|mining]] world [[Little Capella]] was discovered shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], crews of workers were reassigned there from Feldwes.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Feldwes was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square Q-6.<ref name="TEA" />
